topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's learning objectives and frames the discussion around the hallmarks of cancer and loss of growth control.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferation and Growth Signaling Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations deregulate signaling cascades to promote autonomous growth and proliferation.

topics.label: Differentiation Blocks in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how differentiation blocks prevent cells from exiting the cell cycle across hematopoietic and solid tissue cancers.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms, including p53-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization, that cancer cells alter to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality, Telomeres, and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells overcome replicative limits through telomerase reactivation while bypassing normal senescence pathways.

topics.label: Deregulated Cancer Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells rewire their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis and oncometabolite signaling to support sustained growth.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the physiological requirement for new blood vessel formation and the regulation of the angiogenic switch in tumor progression.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Characteristics of Cancer Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the biological stages, microenvironmental interactions, and genomic features underlying metastatic dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by summarising the integration of cancer hallmarks and inviting questions for upcoming practical sessions.
